fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are the JSON-LD NewsArticle object spread verbatim -- Axios emits ld+json as a list ([NewsMediaOrganization, NewsArticle]) rather than a bare dict, but the extractor picks out the NewsArticle entry. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) come from Axios's unusually rich RSS 2.0 feed, which carries a full content:encoded body, multiple dc:creator co-byline tags, and a media:content thumbnail. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, if carried in the JSON-LD block.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

content.title: Content (RSS)
content.description: Full article body from the RSS item's content:encoded field (latest mode).

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: List of dc:creator byline names, supporting co-bylines (latest mode).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> tags from the RSS item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
